doc: Monster modifier ids (monumod.txt row id, as stored in MonsterData.Enchants) to display names, for the senses elite markers (TASK-152, docs/senses-units.md). tag: S = id read from the real monumod.txt by the combat package (internal/combat/target.go affixByMod), name taken from the Codex champion table (firsts_act1.json); U = id or name not checked. That the client's enchant array holds these ids is U (D2BS offset, no live champion read yet). Ids not listed read 'unknown mod #N'; extend this file, never the code.
